messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — bringup of rewind-13b-quant4 shows late-token divergence when replaying very long prefixes (~60k). Repro below.

sara: repro script?

jamie: pastebin with script but quick command:
```
python -m infra.tests.replay --model rewind-13b-q --quant int4 --prefix-file long_prompt.jsonl --max-tokens 60000 --compare-ref float
```

michael: saw a similar pattern on a different shard last week — drift starts after ~57k and is sparse.

devon: logs snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-02-12T10:23:45Z] kv_sync: idx=57823 expected=0x7f1a2 got=0x3c9f4  // mismatch after wrap
[2026-02-12T10:23:45Z] rope_scale: factor=1.0001 -> 0.9996 after quant path
```

sara: :eyes: Could be RoPE scaling/rounding + shard packing. Is this only int4?

jamie: int8 shows much lower divergence. int4 and quant4_hybrid both show it. Running with rotary-rescale disabled seems to postpone the divergence.

michael: hypothesis: quant path uses a different scaling/rescale op (per-embedding) and we lose high-freq phase precision -> wrap misalignment in K/V indices.

devon: steps I'm going to run:
- reproduce on 3 different seeds/shards
- run with `--log-kv-index` to dump idx before/after prefill
- try forcing consistent rotary scaling across quant/fp32 paths

sara: also try gagging prefix caching (disable prefix cache) to see if it's cache-specific or repro in streaming mode.

jamie: quick perf note — disabling rotary-rescale makes latency slightly worse but if it stabilizes correctness we can patch.

michael: add a guard in runtime: if kv_idx mismatch detected, fallback to ref model and emit alert. short-term mitigation.

devon: created ticket INF-3121, linked the dump. Will push canary with extra kv-index checks to dedicated cluster vpc-canary-2.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/patch/kv-guard -> vpc-canary-2 at 16:00 UTC :rocket:

sara: thanks. If someone can triage the dumps I can start drilling on quant kernel rescale paths tomorrow.

jamie: @michael @devon thanks. I'll collect longer logs and run the int8 vs int4 smoke matrix (matrix dimensions: prompt length x quant x shard packing) and post results here.

michael: :thumbsup:
